annotations.title: Send a chart whenever it changes

description: Post a living chart to a destination every time its data changes (through update_living_chart or the API), and by default once right now. For a fixed daily or weekly time use schedule_chart instead. Returns a confirmation. Needs a connection signed in to a free account (connector URL ending in /mcp/account).

chart_id.description: The chart id from create_living_chart or list_my_charts.

destination_id.description: The destination id from add_destination or list_my_charts.

send_now.description: Also send it once now (default true).

name: send_chart_on_update
title: Send a chart whenever it changes
